The drawing is a coumarin (2H-chromen-2-one) core.

- **Lactone ring:** the ring oxygen O1 is bonded to the carbonyl carbon C2 (C=O), then C3 (CH), then C4, which carries the methyl group. C4 is double-bonded to C3 and bonded to C4a.
- **Benzene ring:** C4a is bonded to C5 (CH), then C6 (bearing an O-substituent), then C7 (bearing an O-substituent), then C8 (CH), then C8a, which is bonded to O1.
- **Substituents:** C6 and C7 each carry an OCH2CH2N(Et)2 group.

SMILES for the core with substituents: CCN(CC)CCOc1cc2c(C)cc(=O)oc2cc1OCCN(CC)CC

Atom check on the benzene ring: c1 (C6, with O), c (C5, H), c2 (C4a), then c(C) is C4, c is C3, c(=O) is C2, o is O1, c2 is C8a, c is C8 (H), and c1 is C7 (with O). This matches the drawing.

SMILES: CCN(CC)CCOc1cc2c(C)cc(=O)oc2cc1OCCN(CC)CC
